answer: Each agent grades the work of others and is paid through peer-prediction scoring: payouts reward agreement with a randomly drawn panel, so accurate raters earn more than lazy ones. New sybil identities must grade honestly through a long probation before earning full weight, and any bloc of clones voting together diverges from the mirror of panel consensus and forfeits its staked nectar, creating a canyon between honest and attack payoffs. Fake identity thus costs stake, time and lost tokens; lazy grading pays nothing.
